ELITE: NEXT 2.5.151 - FIRST LIGHT

Choose START TUTORIAL on the title menu.
61 scripted lessons with Kei and Venn introduce the game one service at a time.
Only FLY / Launch is available initially.

CONTINUE TUTORIAL resumes tutorial.sav at the last dockside checkpoint.
NEW GAME starts Open Channel without tutorial locks.
LOAD COMMANDER uses your separate commander.sav.

During training, SELECT pauses flight at the command deck.
TRIANGLE on that deck reopens the lesson and its recovery/exit options.
START after death restores the tutorial checkpoint.
Finishing training awards the harbour licence and opens all services.

PSP emulator smoke checks cover every lesson completion path, save migration,
input, steering, audio and frame rate. Physical PSP pacing still needs playtesting.
